events.description: Multiple players from Boston Bruins (black/yellow jerseys) and Montreal Canadiens (white/blue/red jerseys) engage in a sustained on-ice brawl near the boards and goal crease, involving grappling, punching, and shoving; referees intervene to separate them.

Two ice hockey players engage in a prolonged physical fight on the ice, exchanging punches and grappling, culminating in one player (in black/yellow jersey #30) being taken down and pinned by the other (in white/red/blue jersey #31), with both eventually on the ice and entangled until a referee intervenes.

Two ice hockey players are engaged in a physical fight on the ice: one player (in black and yellow goalie gear) is on the ice while the other (in dark jersey with white/blue trim) is on top, grappling and attempting to strike; the fight continues as they shift positions until a referee intervenes.

The standing player delivers repeated strikes to the downed goalie who is on the ice and appears unable to effectively defend himself, constituting abuse of a helpless victim during the initial phase of the altercation.

A physical fight erupts in the corner of the rink near the boards, involving multiple players from opposing teams (Montreal Canadiens in red/white/blue and Boston Bruins in yellow/black). Players are seen grappling, shoving, and throwing punches while others converge on the scene.
A Montreal player (No. 21) is down on the ice near the boards and appears to be struck by a Boston player while in a vulnerable position, consistent with attacking a helpless victim.

Multiple players from Montreal Canadiens (white/blue/red) and Boston Bruins (yellow/black) engage in a sustained on-ice brawl along the boards, involving punching, grappling, and shoving; referees intervene progressively but the fight continues across multiple frames.

A Bruins player (No. 28, Ference) appears to deliver repeated punches to a downed or heavily restrained Canadiens player near the boards while others are engaged elsewhere; the victim is not actively defending himself during this brief interval.
Two goaltenders engage in a prolonged physical fight on the ice, grappling, wrestling, and taking each other to the ice; the fight continues until officials intervene and separate them.

After being taken down, the black-and-yellow goaltender is pinned on the ice while the white-and-red goaltender delivers repeated punches or strikes to the head/upper body of the downed opponent, constituting abuse of a helpless victim.

Two hockey players are engaged in a physical fight on the ice: one player (in black and yellow, likely a goalie) is on his knees while the other (in dark jersey with white sleeves) is on top of him, grappling and delivering punches. The struggle continues as they shift positions, with both participants actively involved in mutual combat.

After the initial mutual combat subsides, the standing player (dark jersey) continues to hold and push down the kneeling player (goalie), who appears unable to rise or defend himself effectively, while the referee intervenes. This phase shows potential targeting of a disadvantaged opponent.
